test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 03 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
‘P + F’ means ‘P is the son of F’

‘P – F’ means ‘P is the wife of F’

‘P × F’ means ‘P is the brother of F’

‘P ÷ F’ means ‘P is the mother of F’

‘P = F’ means ‘P is the sister of F’.

What does ‘K = R ÷ M’ mean?

options.text: K is the aunt (mother’s sister) of M
K is the daughter of M
K is the niece of M
K is the sister of M

solution:

Given: K = R ÷ M

K = R → K is the sister of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e2d205d985f4b6ad3ee83f0eb9d39850edc117bad4f072a3b5abebd827eed84d.png] 

R ÷ M → R is the mother of M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aaf14c6f470eea77729b1103e43a525298048491a308afa4e580ce07b98d4954.png] 

Here, K is the maternal aunt or mother’s sister of M.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
